final: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM film f LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id LEFT JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS avg_count FROM rating_counts) SELECT AVG(rc.rental_count) AS average_count_above_overall, AVG(rc.rental_count - o.avg_count) AS average_excess_overall FROM rating_counts rc CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE rc.rental_count > o.avg_count
